summary: Backend-only regression + new CoinSwitch live-order plumbing tested via pytest against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. 16/16 tests passed. All existing endpoints unchanged. New /api/coinswitch/check correctly returns 400 with 'CoinSwitch keys not configured in .env'. /api/telemetry now exposes coinswitch_client_ready=false (no keys in .env). LIVE-mode toggle with missing keys logs ERROR '[LIVE] {coin} skipped — CoinSwitch keys missing.' per coin cycle and does not crash the engine (bot remains running=true, no LIVE positions created); paper mode simulator continues to produce trades. Direct import of CoinSwitchFuturesClient works; Ed25519 signature (both GET-with-params and POST-no-params) verifies against derived public key, confirming signing format METHOD+urllib.parse.unquote_plus(path_with_query)+epoch_ms with body excluded.
passed: GET /api/status, /api/spreads, /api/positions/open, /api/positions/closed, /api/config, PUT /api/config, /api/logs, /api/equity-curve, /api/hourly-summary all 200 with expected {items:[...]} shape
POST /api/coinswitch/check -> 400 detail 'CoinSwitch keys not configured in .env'
LIVE toggle produces ERROR log entries '[LIVE] <coin> skipped — CoinSwitch keys missing.' (26 entries observed after ~4s), bot stays running, no crash
Paper simulator continues to open/close trades (trade counter increments over 25s window)
CoinSwitchFuturesClient importable; _sign() signature verifies via Ed25519 public key for GET+params and POST
critical_code_review_comments: coinswitch_client._sign() leaks internal key '_signed_path' via the returned headers dict; caller must strip it before send (already done in _request but any external use of _sign as a helper would send this header to the exchange). Consider returning (headers, signed_path) tuple.

bot_engine.py _open_position LIVE branch logs '[LIVE] {coin} skipped — CoinSwitch keys missing.' on every candidate cycle — expected produces high log volume (~26 entries in a few seconds during LIVE mode without keys). Consider one-time WARN + suppress duplicates, or gate at loop entry.

Live mode has no preflight guard: switching to LIVE mode via /api/bot/mode succeeds even when ENGINE.coinswitch is None. Recommend /api/bot/mode invoke /api/coinswitch/check-style validation before flipping to LIVE, or at least return {warning: 'client_not_ready'} in the response.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter2 pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_iter2.py is the current regression suite. Response shapes are {items:[...]} for spreads/positions/logs/equity-curve/positions/closed. LIVE-mode branch is exercised via mode toggle + log verification only (no real CoinSwitch calls). If real keys are added later, /api/coinswitch/check should return {ok:true, wallet_balance:{...}} and coinswitch_client_ready should flip to true after service restart.
